proposed_hypothesis_text: Non-English prior art systematically inflates the auto-evaluator's novelty score because the evaluator's query expansion is English-centric and misses on rebutting work in Chinese, German, or French even when it is indexed.
rationale: Same evaluator (auto-evaluator) and same directional effect (novelty inflation), but the mechanism is different: paywall vs. language barrier.
